skill.name: subject-line-lab
skill.description: Generates and pre-scores email subject lines with matched preheaders. It checks heuristic spam triggers, truncation, emoji use, and inbox previews.
skill.summary: Generate, compare, and pre-screen email subject line variants before testing.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown links, inline formatting, code fences, and homepage metadata. Two risks remain: an unsanitized filename placeholder can permit path traversal, and a local script invocation lacks a defined safe argument boundary.

remediation.issue: The save filename includes a user-derived offer value without stated sanitization.
remediation.suggestion: Convert the offer to a restricted basename and verify the resolved path remains inside memory/email/subject-line-lab before writing.

remediation.issue: The registry-events.py workflow does not specify a safe invocation method.
remediation.suggestion: Use structured arguments without shell interpolation, validate claim text, and request confirmation before running the local script.

content.user_title: Generate and Pre-Score Email Subject Lines
content.value_statement: Weak subject lines waste test traffic and may truncate important promises. This skill generates variants and ranks them with clear heuristic checks.
actual_capabilities: Generates three to eight subject lines across distinct messaging angles.
Pairs each subject line with a matching preheader and stable variant identifier.
Counts characters and flags likely desktop or mobile truncation.
Flags listed spam patterns, deceptive prefixes, symbol stacking, and unsupported scarcity.
Counts emoji and applies different guidance for promotional, newsletter, and cold outreach modes.
Renders inbox previews and ranks variants with stated reasons.
limitations: Heuristic checks cannot guarantee inbox placement or predict provider filters.
The skill does not verify SPF, DKIM, DMARC, or email body content.
It does not design experiments, calculate significance, or measure campaign results.
Results depend on accurate offer details, audience context, and sender information.

use_cases.title: Prepare Promotional Campaign Variants
use_cases.description: Create benefit, offer, and curiosity variants before a promotional email test.

use_cases.title: Screen Cold Outreach Subjects
use_cases.description: Review concise B2B subjects for truncation, deceptive wording, and unsuitable emoji.

use_cases.title: Improve Newsletter Previews
use_cases.description: Pair newsletter subjects with complementary preheaders and compare mobile inbox previews.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Subject
prompt_templates.prompt: Pre-score this subject and preheader for spam triggers, emoji, and mobile truncation: [subject] | [preheader].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one existing pair

prompt_templates.title: Generate Campaign Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate five promotional subject and preheader pairs for [offer]. Label each angle, show previews, and rank the strongest options.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Existing Candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these subjects for [audience] in [mode]. Preserve their order, assign stable identifiers, flag weaknesses, and recommend three survivors: [subjects].

prompt_templates.title: Use Historical Performance Context
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this campaign export, identify effective angles, generate six new variants for [offer], pre-score them, and explain every cut: [data].

output_examples.input: Generate promotional subjects for a verified 20 percent weekend discount.
output: Preheader: Shop the verified offer before Sunday.
Measured length: 26 characters. Estimated mobile promise: intact. Spam flags: none.
Recommendation: Advance because the offer appears early and the preview adds useful timing.

output_examples.input: Pre-score: RE: Your free guaranteed prize!!!
output: Deceptive prefix, exclamation stacking, and dense spam wording were flagged.
Recommendation: Cut this candidate. Replace false familiarity and unsupported claims with a direct, factual benefit.

best_practices: Provide the verified offer, audience, sender name, mode, and any required brand terms.
Treat spam and truncation results as estimates, then test shortlisted variants with controlled experiments.
Keep important benefits early and make each preheader extend rather than repeat its subject.
anti_patterns: Do not request fabricated prices, scarcity, statistics, or personalization claims.
Do not treat a clean heuristic result as an inbox placement guarantee.
Do not compare variants that change several unrelated campaign elements at once.

faq.question: Does this skill guarantee inbox placement?
faq.answer: No. It provides heuristic content checks, not mailbox-provider scoring or placement guarantees.

faq.question: Can it generate preheaders?
faq.answer: Yes. It pairs each subject with a preheader that extends the message.

faq.question: Does it review the email body?
faq.answer: No. Its review covers subject lines and preheaders only.

faq.question: Can it use past campaign data?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a manual export to inform angle and length recommendations.

faq.question: Does it run an A/B test?
faq.answer: No. It prepares ranked variants for a separate testing workflow.

faq.question: Which campaign modes are supported?
faq.answer: It supports promotional, lifecycle, cold outreach, and newsletter subject line work.
